subject: POC credit uplift request — BroadField large-context evaluation
messages:
From: Ellis Conway <ellis@broadfield.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@broadfield.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: POC request — expanded window & higher token throughput

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising. To evaluate Redwood properly we need a POC that mirrors realistic usage: 60k token context windows for retrieval-augmented generation across ~8 concurrent sessions, with sustained bursts that push TPM up to ~1.2M tokens/minute for short periods.

Our CS and infra teams asked whether you can increase the initial trial credits and extend the trial from 14 to 45 days so we can run full-scale tests (embedding + chat + streaming outputs). Right now the self-serve allotment looks too small for that scope. Ideally we’d get:
- 200,000 free credits (to cover compute and inference costs for the POC)
- 45-day window

We can share a simple acceptance test and expected throughput profiles (I attached the POC spec and expected-token-load.csv).

Would Redwood be able to issue this as a self-serve uplift or do we need a manual issuance? We’re ready to sign an ROI memo if that helps.

Best,
Ellis Conway
Director of Applied ML
BroadField Analytics

--
Attachment: broadfield-poc-specs.pdf
Attachment: expected-token-load.csv
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Conway <ellis@broadfield.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC request — expanded window & higher token throughput

Hi Ellis — thanks for the spec and for laying out the load profile so clearly. Appreciate the context.

Quick answers: 1) We can support larger context POCs; our Dedicated config and some hosted variants handle 60k windows. 2) We typically issue self-serve trial credit uplift for PLG signups up to a threshold; beyond that we require a short approval path.

To move fast, can you confirm the following so I can loop in Finance and Marissa from commercial:
- Is the POC expected to ingest customer data requiring any special residency/SOC controls?
- Do you need logs/audit export for the POC?
- Preferred start date for the 45-day period?

If nothing unusual on compliance, I’ll propose a conditional uplift: 150k credits immediate self-serve, with a manual top-up to 200k pending a short run-rate forecast and a one-page ROI note. That keeps us comfortable on misuse and aligns with internal guardrails.

I’ll cc Marissa and Aditya for approval flow. Thanks —
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC request — expanded window & higher token throughput

Looping in Finance. Vivek — I’m fine with the conditional approach. Approve: 150,000 credits issued now (self-serve token/code) + manual top-up of 50,000 credits if BroadField provides the 7-day expected usage snapshot after week 1 and confirms no sensitive data residency requirement.

Conditions:
- Trial window capped at 45 days starting from activation.
- Credits expire at end of window; any extension requires a brief business justification.
- We’ll monitor for anomalous TPM and can throttle if abuse detected.

Aditya — can you generate the code and share issuance steps? Also add HubSpot deal note and set a task to review POC metrics on Day 8.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Commercial Operations
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ellis Conway <ellis@broadfield.ai>
Date: 2026-04-13T09:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC request — expanded window & higher token throughput

Ellis — thanks, we’ve issued the initial uplift as discussed. Details below:

- Issuance method: Self-serve promo code (applies to BroadField signup email domain).
- Promo code: BF-POC-150K-APR26
- Value: 150,000 credits (usable across embeddings, chat, streaming)
- Validity: Activate within 14 days; once activated the 45-day trial window begins.
- Top-up: Additional 50,000 credits available upon receipt of the Day-7 usage snapshot and confirmation there are no data residency constraints. Send to aditya_rao@redwood.ai.

Activation steps (for BroadField):
1) Log into the Redwood Console using the PLG account created during signup (or create one with the BroadField domain).
2) Navigate to Billing -> Promo Codes -> Redeem code.
3) Enter BF-POC-150K-APR26 and click Apply.

Monitoring & safety: We’ll instrument a short-lived usage tracker on the HubSpot deal and set an alert at 700k TPM sustained for 3 minutes. If triggered we will reach out and may implement temporary throttling until we confirm the pattern.

HubSpot: noted on deal RDW-2026-BF-17 and set a reminder for Day 8 metrics review.

Best,
Aditya
Growth Ops — Redwood Inference

--
Related link: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/BD-17822
From: Ellis Conway <ellis@broadfield.ai>

Date: 2026-04-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC request — expanded window & higher token throughput

Fantastic — thank you all. BF-POC-150K-APR26 provides the runway we need to kick off parallel tests across retrieval and streaming. We’ll activate by Monday (2026-04-19) and share the Day-7 usage snapshot as requested.

A couple of quick clarifications for our infra team:
- Is the promo code domain-restricted to @broadfield.ai?
- Can we request a one-time audit log export for the POC after the run?

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Ellis
